passage: The summer art tour visits three cities known for their museums and galleries. Students on the tour will stop in Lyon, France; Turin, ______ and Geneva, Switzerland.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: The list items contain commas ("Lyon, France").
When list items contain commas, semicolons separate the items.
The first item already uses a semicolon, so "Italy" needs one too.
A comma would blur the items, and a colon doesn't separate list items.
key: Use semicolons between list items that already contain commas.
